findings.title: Task 8 Step 5's flightPointer import instruction says to replace three lines while also saying two of them stay
findings.claim: The step says 'Its first import line and the two after it become' and then gives three lines (consoleLayout, readoutModel, theme). The parenthetical says the tacticalModel and resolution imports stay. But in flightPointer.ts the two lines after the first import are exactly the tacticalModel and resolution imports (L4-5). A subagent that follows the sentence literally replaces L3-5 and drops `headingOf`, `pickRadius`, `INTERNAL_W` and `INTERNAL_H`, which flightPointer and the new onWeaponsMap both use, so tsc fails.
findings.evidence: plan L2230-2236 (the 'first import line and the two after it become' sentence with the 'stay' parenthetical); src/renderer/src/app/duel/flightPointer.ts:L3-5 (consoleLayout, then tacticalModel, then resolution); flightPointer.ts:L21, L43-44 (INTERNAL_W/H, pickRadius and headingOf in use)
findings.why: The plan is executed verbatim. The sentence and its parenthetical contradict each other, and one reading does not compile.
findings.fix: Reword to: 'Line 3 (the consoleLayout import) becomes the first line below, and the readoutModel and theme imports are inserted right after it. Lines 4-5 (tacticalModel, resolution) stay unchanged.'
